remarks: Welcome to 141 Cavalry Road, a 4-bedroom colonial on 2.16 private acres in Wilton's southeast corner, bordering Weston and Westport. The main level centers around an open flow of living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and kitchen with appliances under 3 years old. The dining room opens to a screened porch with jalousie windows and sliding door to the large deck. The family room features a 2nd fireplace with a striking brick accent wall. Also on this level: a dedicated office, half bath, and main floor laundry with a laundry chute from the second floor linen closet. There are hardwood floors throughout most of these spaces. Upstairs, the primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a walk-through closet, and a reading nook. Three additional bedrooms and two fully renovated bathrooms (2024) complete the upper level. The walk-out basement is spacious, fully waterproofed with trench drains and sump pump, and ready to be finished. The backyard is level and serene, with full privacy from neighbors, and birds chirping all spring. Host barbecues on the deck and patio, or kick a ball around, the options are endless. There is a large attic adjacent to the bedrooms and a two-car garage. The home has easy access to the Merritt Parkway, the Westport YMCA, downtown Weston, and more. Located in Wilton's closest neighborhood to Westport train station, this home offers privacy and convenience in one of Fairfield County's most desirable towns.
